campaigner for the blind

The blind daughter of a bishop, she had founded the Association for Promoting the General Welfare of the Blind, starting with a school in Holborn in 1854; see Gordon Goodwin, ‘Gilbert, Elizabeth Margaretta Maria (1826–1885)’, rev.

Kenneth R.

Whitton, Oxford Dictionary of National Biography, Oxford University Press, 2004.
